cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Find the Real Authority
cards.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The pipe's still leaking. Which signature releases the repair money? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All three. I've spent all morning getting them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Could anyone still freeze it after your morning's work?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance could. Though they unfroze the roof payment when the caretaker called.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the caretaker have: permission to overrule finance, or someone else's direct number?
